order_note: Recommend house/food first, then people (parents, friend), then reflective topics (earliest memory). Elder may pick any.

topics.opening_question: Let's start with your name. Do you know how you got it?
follow_ups: Who picked it out?
Did anyone call you something different growing up?
How did you feel about your name as a kid?

topics.topic_zh: 我的父母是什么样的人
topics.opening_question: When you picture your mom or dad back then, what do you see them doing?
follow_ups: What did they do for work?
What's something they used to say all the time?
How did you know they cared about you?
Was there a time you saw a different side of them?

topics.opening_question: Did you know your grandparents growing up?
follow_ups: What was their house like?
What did you do together?
Is there something they said that stuck with you?

topics.topic_en: The house I grew up in
topics.opening_question: Tell me about the house you grew up in. What did you see when you walked in the front door?
follow_ups: Where did you sleep? Did you share a room?
What did it smell like at dinnertime?
Where was your favorite spot in that house?
Is the house still there?

topics.opening_question: What was your street like when you were little?
follow_ups: Who lived next door?
Where did the kids hang out?
Was there a store or place everyone went to?

topics.topic_en: Food I loved as a kid
topics.opening_question: What was a food you couldn't wait to eat as a kid?
follow_ups: Who made it?
When did you get to have it?
Can you still taste it? Have you ever had it that way since?

topics.opening_question: Who was your best friend when you were little?
follow_ups: How did you two meet?
What did you get up to together?
Did you stay in touch?

topics.opening_question: Which holiday did your family make the biggest deal about?
follow_ups: What was on the table?
Who came over?
Is there one year you'll never forget?
A gift you still remember?

topics.opening_question: What did summer look like when you were a kid?
follow_ups: Did your family go anywhere?
What did a perfect summer day look like?
What time did you have to be home?

topics.opening_question: What's the very first thing you can remember?
follow_ups: About how old were you?
Do you remember it yourself, or is it a story you heard later?
What do you see when you picture it?

topics.opening_question: Did you ever get into trouble as a kid?
follow_ups: Did you get caught?
What happened when your parents found out?
Would you do it again?

topics.opening_question: Some families went through hard times back then. Is that something you'd like to talk about, or would you rather skip it?
follow_ups: Only if you want to: what do you remember most?
How did your family get through it?
